summary: Trivial pointer accessor: returns the receiver pointer advanced by 100 bytes (this + 100). No memory read or write is performed, so the function exposes the member region at receiver offset 100 as a sub-object pointer. Called by sub_57BF00 and sub_584230.

local_names.this: receiver whose offset-100 member is exposed

operations.description: Pointer arithmetic only: result = this + 100 bytes. Pure address advance, no dereference.
Returns the advanced pointer, exposing the member region at receiver offset 100 (0x64) as a sub-object pointer.
Invoked as an accessor by sub_57BF00 and sub_584230.

unresolved: The semantic identity of the member at offset 100 (which sub-object it exposes) is not derivable from this packet; only the byte displacement is known.
